CITY OF LA VERNE

  SPECIAL MEETING

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA
  TELECONFERENCE NOTICE
  Watch live at
  www.cityoflaverne.org

Tim Hepburn, Mayor  www.cityoflaverne.org
  (909) 596-8726 - Phone
Robin Carder, Mayor Pro Tem
  (909) 596-8740 - Fax
Muir Davis, Council Member
  City Hall Council Chamber
Rick Crosby, Council Member
  3660 D Street
Wendy Lau, Council Member
  La Verne, CA 91750

  Tuesday, June 9, 2020 at 4:30 pm.

  Tonight’s Council meeting will again be closed to the public in compliance with Governor Newsom’s
  Executive Order to minimize the spread of the COVID 19 Virus. However, the City would
  encourage public participation in our meeting and as such want to make residents aware of the
  following opportunities on how to participate:

  1. View the meeting live through the City’s website at www.cityoflaverne.org and following the link
  titled “Council Meeting Live Stream” or on YouTube at www.cityoflaverne.org/youtube.

  2. Please submit your comments via email to planning@cityoflaverne.org. We ask that you
  provide those emails before 12:00 pm, so that staff will be prepared to read them aloud at the
  appropriate time.

  3. Also, if you wish to make a comment during the meeting. We will be monitoring the email address
  and will make every effort to include your comment into the records. Please be aware there is a
  delay in the live stream service and any comments should be submitted as soon as possible.

  4. For individuals that wish to share their comments directly during the live stream, you may email
  planning@cityoflaverne.org by 12:00 pm the day of the meeting with a phone number and the
  item(s) you wish to speak on. We will call you back at the appropriate time during the meeting
  for your comment.

  In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
  modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s
  Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st
  rd
  and 3 Monday of every month.
 AGENDA, La Verne City Council Special Meeting, Tuesday, June 9, 2020, Page 2

1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

3.  ROLL CALL:  Council Member Lau, Council Member Crosby, Council Member Davis ,
  Mayor Pro Tem Carder and Mayor Hepburn.

4.  PUBLIC COMMENTS/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - This is the time set aside for anyone
  wishing to address the City Council on items not listed in any other place on the agenda.
  Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the legislative body is prohibited from talking or
  engaging in discussion on any item not appearing on the posted agenda. However, your
  concerns may be referred to staff or set for discussion at a later date. There is a three-
  minute limit per speaker. Please email planning@cityoflaverne.org before 12:00 pm on the
  day of the meeting with your public comments.

5.  Planning Commission and Active Transportation Interviews

  a. Planning Commission Applicants Interviews - On March 12, 2020, the Assistant City Clerk
  gave notice of an existing vacancy on the Planning Commission A total of seven (7)
  applications were received. City Council will interview the following:

  Thomas Allison  Barbara DeMirjyn  Raymond Herbert
  Michael Grossman  Thomas Boyle
  Charles Hill  Jeremy Conrad

  b. Active Transportation Committee Applicant Interviews - On March 12, 2020, the Assistant
  City Clerk gave notice of an existing vacancy on the Active Transportation Committee. A total
  of three (3) applications were received. City Council will interview the following:

  Steven Wagner
  Roy Halberg
  Stuart Wood

6.  ADJOURNMENT

  THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING
  of the La Verne City Council is scheduled
  for Monday, June 15, 2020, at 6:30 pm

ADVISORY STAFF
____ Robert Russi, City Manager
____ Dan Keesey, Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Works
____ Robert Kress, City Attorney
____ Eric Scherer, Director of Community Development

Posting Statement: A true and correct copy of this Agenda was posted on Tuesday, June 04, 2020,
on the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, CA and on the City’s website
www@cityoflaverne.org.
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE
  Tuesday, June 9, 2020

1.  In order to minimize the spread of the COVID 19 Virus, Governor Newsom issued an Executive Order that
  temporarily suspends requirements of the Brown Act. The Council Chambers was closed to the public, La Verne
  City Council Members attended this meeting telephonically, and the meeting was live streamed on the City' s
  website.

2.  A special meeting of the La Verne City Council was called to order by Mayor Tim Hepburn at 4: 30 pm.

3.  Council Members present:  Mayor Tim Hepburn
  Mayor Pro Tern Robin Carder
  Council Member Muir Davis
  Council Member Wendy Lau
  Council Member Rick Crosby

  Absent:  None.

  Advisory personnel present:  City Manager Robert Russi
  City Attorney Robert L. Kress
  Assistant City Manager/ Public Works Director Dan Keesey
  Assistant City Clerk Lupe Gaeta Estrella
  Community Development Director Eric Scherer

4.  Pledge of Allegiance

5.  Public Comment  PUBLIC COMMENTS/ ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - This is the time
  set aside for anyone wishing to address the City Council on items not
  listed in any other place on the agenda. Under the provisions of the
  Brown Act, the legislative body is prohibited from talking or engaging in
  discussion on any item not appearing on the posted agenda. However,
  your concerns may be referred to staff or set for discussion at a later
  date. There is a 3- minute limit per speaker.

  Mayor Hepburn called for public comment on this item and waited a few
  minutes for staff to check for any public comments received via email.

  Jackson Salinas—( email attached)

 6.  Planning Commission and  The City Council met telephonically to interview the Planning Commission and
  Active Transportation  Active Transportation Applicants as follows:
  Interviews

  Planning Commission  Planning Commission Applicants Interviews - On March 12, 2020, the
  Interviews  Assistant City Clerk gave notice of an existing vacancy on the Planning
  Commission. A total of seven ( 7) applications were received. City Council
  interviewed the following applicants:
   City Council Minutes, Special Meeting, Tuesday, June 9, 2020, Page 2

  Thomas Allison  Barbara DeMirjyn  Raymond Herbert

  Michael Grossman  Thomas Boyle
  Charles Hill  Jeremy Conrad

  After the interviews, it was the consensus of the City Council to appoint
  Thomas Allison to the Planning Commission to serve the unexpired term of
  Wendy Lau until July 1, 2022.

7.  Active Transportation  Active Transportation Committee Applicant Interviews - On March 12, 2020,
  Interviews  the Assistant City Clerk gave notice of an existing vacancy on the Active
  Transportation Committee. A total of three ( 3) applications were received. City
  Council will interview the following:

  Steven Wagner
  Roy Halberg
  Stuart Wood

  After the interviews it was the consensus of the City Council to appoint Roy
  Halberg to the Active Transportation Committee to serve the unexpired term of
  Matt Hawkesworth until August 1, 2023.

8.  Adjournment at 6: 50 pm.

  Respectfully submitted,

  Lupe Gaeta Estrella, CMC
  Assistant City Clerk
